# Quotation -- RAUTAPORTTI-RFQ-2026-09

Visakoivu Oy, Jyvaskyla -- technical maintenance framework agreement

## 3. Eligibility

3.1 Visakoivu Oy holds the required LUSA competence certificate.

3.2 Visakoivu's liability insurance meets the required minimum cover.

3.3 Visakoivu holds sahkourakointioikeudet class S1, the unrestricted electrical contracting classification, which covers all installation types and voltage levels within class S2 and exceeds it; the minimum-S2 requirement is therefore satisfied.

## 4. Technical requirements

4.1 Building envelope condition inspections are carried out annually, covering roofing, facades and building fabric, with a written findings report to estate management.

4.2 Service continuity through personnel changes is managed via cross-trained teams and documented handover procedures, so no single point of failure sits with one named engineer.

4.3 Reporting to estate management follows a monthly format covering completed work, open faults and upcoming preventive maintenance, with an annual summary.

4.4 Quality control and testing follow our NMSB 7310:2015 quality management system, with documented checks after each maintenance visit.

4.5 Statutory periodic inspections of electrical installations are scheduled and carried out in accordance with the required intervals, with certificates issued to the buyer.

4.6 Lift servicing is carried out in accordance with statutory requirements, by qualified subcontracted specialists under our oversight where Visakoivu does not hold direct lift-servicing authorisation.

4.7 All technicians deployed hold the qualifications required for their trade and carry evidence on site.

4.8 Installed equipment carries a standard 24-month warranty from commissioning.

## 5. Commercial terms

5.1 We accept a price-index clause tied to an agreed cost index, reviewed annually.

5.2 A cost breakdown is provided in accordance with the required format.

5.3 Pricing is quoted in EUR.

5.4 Invoicing is monthly, itemised per property and work order.

## 6. Forms

6.1 A certificate of pension insurance payments is enclosed.

6.2 An insurance certificate is enclosed.

## 7. Quotation format

7.1 This quotation is submitted ahead of the deadline of 6 October 2026, 15:00 EET.

7.2 The framework pricing reference currency is EUR.

7.3 This quotation is submitted as a single PDF, not password-protected.

## Liite A -- Tekninen erittely

2.2 Installation work follows a documented method statement covering sequencing, testing and handover for each work order.

2.3 Standard-stock spare parts are held at our Jyvaskyla depot; non-stock parts are typically delivered within 3-5 working days.

3.2 Visakoivu operates round-the-clock (24/7) fault-response duty within Finland, drawing on standby arrangements already in place under our current public-sector maintenance agreements. This will be extended to cover this framework.

## Liite B -- Lomakkeet ja kaupalliset ehdot

1.1 Subcontractor costs are itemised for transparency where subcontracted work forms part of an invoice.

2.1 CVs of key personnel proposed for this framework are enclosed.
